sloka: इत्युक्तः प्रश्रितं वाक्यं धर्मार्थसहितं हितम् ।परुषं वालिना रामो निहतेन विचेतसा ॥४-१८-१॥
transliteration: ityuktaḥ praśritaṁ vākyaṁ dharmārthasahitaṁ hitam ।paruṣaṁ vālinā rāmo nihatena vicetasā ॥4-18-1॥

translations.english: To these harsh words though seemingly wellmeaning, courteous and righteous, Vali who had been mortally wounded and confused in mind, Rama replied:
